name: Ulte Mail Sync with MailerLite for WooCommerce
author: stockeven

sections.description:
Ulte Mail Sync connects a WooCommerce store to MailerLite e-commerce. Orders, abandoned carts and products reach MailerLite within seconds, so purchase and abandoned cart automations, product blocks and revenue reports work with complete data.

What is sent

  • Orders: customer email, items, total and status. A placed order, paid or waiting for a bank transfer, marks the customer as a buyer and stops a running abandoned cart automation. Cancelled and refunded orders are removed from MailerLite.
  • Abandoned carts: when a shopper enters an email address at checkout and leaves, the cart is sent as an unpaid order, which starts MailerLite’s abandoned cart automation.
  • Products: name, price, link, image and short description, kept up to date when they change.
  • Subscribers: customers who tick the newsletter checkbox at checkout, optionally into a chosen MailerLite group.

Built not to lose data

  • Every change goes into a queue. If MailerLite or the store is unreachable, it is sent again automatically with growing delays.
  • MailerLite’s rate limit is respected, so large stores and history imports do not fail half way.
  • Changes that cannot be sent are listed in the panel with the reason, and can be sent again with one click.

Newsletter consent

A newsletter checkbox is added to the classic and the block checkout. By default only customers who tick it become subscribers; orders of other customers are still recorded in MailerLite e-commerce. Adding all customers as subscribers is a separate setting.

Existing data

Products and paid orders from the last 12 months can be imported once after connecting.

External services

This plugin sends data to the external services below. Nothing is sent until the store is connected in WooCommerce → Mail Sync.

Ulte service (app.stockeven.com), operated by Event Space Sp. z o.o., Poland. It receives the store’s changes, keeps the queue and sends them to MailerLite.
Data sent: product ID, name, price, URL, image URL and short description; order ID, status, total, items, customer email, first and last name and the newsletter consent flag; cart contents and the email entered at checkout; the site URL, store currency, site name, admin email, plugin and WooCommerce versions; the MailerLite API token (on connection).
Privacy policy: https://ulte.net/privacy/ · Terms: https://ulte.net/terms/

MailerLite (connect.mailerlite.com), operated by MailerLite. The Ulte service sends the data listed above to the MailerLite account that owns the API token.
Privacy policy: https://www.mailerlite.com/legal/privacy-policy · Terms: https://www.mailerlite.com/legal/terms-of-service

Stripe (checkout.stripe.com, billing.stripe.com), only when a paid plan is chosen or billing is managed. The browser is sent to a Stripe page; the store’s admin email is passed to pre-fill the checkout. Stripe processes the payment and issues invoices.
Privacy policy: https://stripe.com/privacy · Terms: https://stripe.com/legal

MailerLite is a trademark of its respective owner. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. Ulte is not affiliated with or endorsed by MailerLite or Automattic.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. In MailerLite open Integrations → MailerLite API and generate a new token.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Mail Sync, paste the token and click Connect.
  4. Optionally import existing products and orders.
sections.faq:
What does it cost?

Free for up to 50 paid orders a month. Starter: 500 orders a month for $9/month. Growth: 2,500 orders for $19/month. Pro: unlimited orders for $39/month. Yearly billing costs ten months. Abandoned carts, products and subscribers are not limited on any plan. Prices are in USD before tax; payment is handled by Stripe, which adds VAT or sales tax where required.

What happens above the monthly limit?

Orders above the limit wait in the queue and are sent right after an upgrade, or on the 1st of the next month. Nothing is lost. While an order waits, its abandoned cart is removed from MailerLite, so the customer does not get abandoned cart emails for a purchase that was made.

Which MailerLite plan is needed?

A plan with API and e-commerce access. On the free plan MailerLite limits the API.

Is the MailerLite token stored in WordPress?

No. The token is sent once to the Ulte service, stored there encrypted and used only to send this store’s data to MailerLite. Disconnecting or uninstalling deletes it.

The MailerLite token allows only some IP addresses. Which ones are needed?

The Ulte service connects from 46.225.79.21 and 2a01:4f8:1c19:2e91::1. Add both to the allowed list of the token, or choose “All IPs allowed”.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes. Abandoned carts and the newsletter checkbox work with the classic and the block checkout. The checkbox in the block checkout requires WooCommerce 8.9 or later.

What happens to orders of customers without consent?

They are recorded in MailerLite e-commerce as orders of customers who do not accept marketing, so revenue reports stay complete. They do not become subscribers unless “Add customers without newsletter consent as subscribers” is switched on.
sections.changelog:
0.2.2

  • Orders carry the WooCommerce status and date; carts carry the checkout link.

0.2.1

  • Email alerts to the store admin when MailerLite rejects the token, changes cannot be sent, or the plan limit is near. Can be switched off in Settings.
  • Notices in WordPress until MailerLite is connected, and when the token is rejected or orders wait for a higher plan.

0.2.0

  • Plans: Free up to 50 paid orders a month, paid plans for larger stores. Plan, usage and invoices in WooCommerce → Mail Sync.
  • Orders above the monthly limit wait and are sent after an upgrade or at the start of the next month.

0.1.3

  • Each purchase gets its own cart in MailerLite, also for logged-in and returning customers.
  • When the cart changes before payment, the MailerLite order gets the items that were actually bought.
  • Orders waiting for an offline payment (on hold) no longer count as abandoned carts.
  • Cancelled and refunded orders are removed from MailerLite e-commerce.

0.1.2

  • Settings page layout: status, import and connection in one column, subscriber settings in the other.
  • FAQ: IP addresses of the Ulte service for MailerLite tokens limited by IP.

0.1.1

  • Changes are sent at once instead of waiting for the next scheduled run; Action Scheduler is used only for retries.
  • The same abandoned cart is not sent again until its email or contents change.
  • History import in steps of 200.

0.1.0

  • First version: orders, abandoned carts, products, subscribers with consent, history import, status panel.
